description.value: Abbotsford Exhibition Park is a large multi-use public grounds operated by the City of Abbotsford Parks Recreation Culture department, serving as a venue for community events, exhibitions, and festivals. Located on Haida Drive in Abbotsford, it draws visitors for major regional events and functions as a community gathering space. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley may find it a useful waypoint or destination during event seasons.
